item.title: ‘I’M HAPPY,’ AT LAST NANCY CAN SMILE
item.description: CELTIC were knocking on wood, but it wasn’t bringing good fortune for under-fire Wilfried Nancy. The Frenchman stood transfixed on the touchline as the new Hoops boss faced a fifth consecutive game without a win after just two and a half weeks in the job. item.title: WATCH AGAIN: CELTIC’S LATE, LATE SHOW
item.description: CELTIC were only a handful of minutes away from dropping their eighth Premiership point from a possible nine as a frustrating afternoon against Aberdeen at Parkhead edged towards a disappointing conclusion. item.title: EVERGREEN CELT’S 17 IN A ROW
item.description: JAMES FORREST left it late last season to maintain his sequence of scoring in every term in sixteen years. Celtic’s evergreen winger popped up in the fading moments of the final Premiership game of the campaign to fire in the equaliser in the 1-1 draw with St Mirren at Parkhead on May 17. item.title: CELTIC IN TV GAME SWITCH
item.description: CELTIC’S Premiership game against Kilmarnock at Rugby Park which was scheduled for Saturday February 14 has been pushed back 24 hours. item.title: JAMES FORREST: THE BHOY FOR ALL SEASONS
